text:
Fortnite - Official Chapter 7 Season 4: Override Release Date Trailer
Take a look at the Chapter 7 Season 4 release date trailer for Fortnite, the latest season for the hit free-to-play battle royale shooter developed by Epic Games. The mission is simple - override the system, take back the Island, and stop Geno before it’s GAME OVER. Chapter 7 Season 4 for Fortnite: Override is launching on August 20 for PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, iOS, Android, and PC (Epic Games Store, GeForce Now, Amazon Luna).

text:
No Visitors Allowed - Official Demo Launch Trailer
Get a look at the demo launch trailer for No Visitors Allowed, a psychological anomaly-horror game set inside a looping abandoned post-Soviet hospital developed by Shak. Players must carefully observe each floor, identify anomalies, and decide whether to continue forward or turn back. No Visitors Allowed is coming soon to PC (Steam), with a demo available now on Steam.
